description: This file contains an Android Activity implementation demonstrating the use of the Trigger Sensor API, specifically the Significant Motion sensor, including an inner class for handling trigger events.

classes.name: TriggerListener
classes.description: Inner class extending TriggerEventListener to handle trigger events, updating the TextView when significant motion is detected.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets content view, obtains the SensorManager, registers the trigger sensor, and sets up the trigger event listener.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Requests trigger sensor activation and updates UI if the sensor is enabled.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Cancels trigger sensor when activity is paused.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Ensures trigger sensor is canceled during activity stop.
